book.title: 装载机把沙子送上车
book.subtitle: 大铲斗的沙坑补给任务
book.question: 装载机怎样把沙子装进车厢？

moral.zh: 合适的工具、适量的装载和清楚的配合，让任务完成得又稳又好。
moral.en: Suitable tools, sensible loads and clear teamwork make a job steady and successful.

parentGuide.goal: 用动作顺序理解装载与运输的分工。
parentGuide.reminder: 不比赛谁装得更多，把注意力放在稳稳完成上。
questions: 装载机和自卸车的任务哪里不同？
为什么铲斗不能一路举得高高的？
parentGuide.activity: 用圆头小铲和大积木给玩具车装货，对比适量装载与堆太高的区别。

ageTips.age4to5: 每次听几个动作就好，允许配音、指图和重复最喜欢的一页。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子解释一次遇到困难后的选择，比较两种车的分工，不要求背术语。

pages.zhText: 新公园要做一个大沙坑。安安抱着小桶，站在参观区想：“这么多沙，用我的小桶要装到什么时候呀？”远处，一辆装载机开来了。
pages.enText: The new park needed a big sandpit. Holding her little pail in the visitor area, An'an wondered, “How long would this take with my bucket?” A wheel loader arrived.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide sand storage yard, An'an holding small pail outside fence, orange-yellow loader approaches inside yard.

pages.zhText: 它的铲斗宽宽的，像一只大簸箕。林工程师说：“今天它要把合适的沙子装上运输车，送去公园。”安安看看小桶，又看看大铲斗，笑了。
pages.enText: Its bucket was broad like a giant dustpan. “Today it will load suitable sand onto a truck for the park,” Lin said. An'an looked from her pail to the bucket and smiled.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium front three-quarter loader broad bucket lowered, tiny pail held by An'an beyond fence for scale.

pages.zhText: 沙堆不止一座！有粗石料，也有细沙。工作人员先核对材料，选好要送的那一堆。大铲斗再能干，也不能装错东西。
pages.enText: There was more than one pile: coarse stone and fine sand. Workers checked the materials and chose the right pile. Even a clever big bucket must collect the right thing.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Separate gravel and clean fine sand stockpiles, Lin checking blank sample trays in safe area, loader stationary.

pages.zhText: 开工前，司机检查轮胎和铲斗，还看看有没有人或东西挡路。四个大轮胎准备好了，铲斗慢慢降到合适的位置。
pages.enText: Before work, the driver checked the tires and bucket and made sure the route was clear. Four big tires were ready, and the bucket lowered into position.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Profile four-tire loader on level clear yard, bucket low ready for work, driver inside cab.

pages.zhText: 铲斗贴近地面向前推，沙子涌了进来。安安在围栏外弯弯手掌：“先把沙子请进来！”沙堆留下一个小小的缺口。
pages.enText: The bucket pushed forward close to the ground, and sand rolled in. An'an curved her hand outside the fence. “Invite the sand in first!” A little hollow appeared in the pile.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close loader bucket entering base of clean sand pile, sand rolling into bucket, no bystanders.

pages.zhText: 接着，铲斗往后收一点，把沙子兜稳。司机没有堆出一座摇摇晃晃的沙山。装得合适，才不容易一路撒落。
pages.enText: Next, the bucket tilted back to hold the sand. The driver did not make a tall, wobbling mountain. A sensible load was less likely to spill along the way.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Bucket tilted back carrying modest sand load below rim, believable hydraulic linkages.

pages.zhText: 装载机倒着退开沙堆。提醒声响起，工作人员早已站到安全位置。妈妈说：“听见提醒，我们也留在围栏外，不往机器后面跑。”
pages.enText: The loader reversed away from the pile. A warning sounded, and workers were already in safe positions. “We stay outside the fence, away from the machine's rear,” Mom said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide loader reversing on empty marked route with low bucket, visitors behind fence well away.

pages.zhText: 转弯时，车身中间好像弯了弯。林工程师说：“这辆装载机用铰接转向，前后两部分改变夹角，帮助它转弯。”
pages.enText: As it turned, the middle of the loader seemed to bend. “This loader has articulated steering,” Lin said. “Its front and rear sections change angle to help it turn.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: High three-quarter loader showing central articulation joint and aligned front/rear sections gently angled, low bucket.

pages.zhText: 运输车已经停稳。司机们确认位置，装载机才慢慢靠近。安安轻声喊：“大铲斗，轮到你抬高啦！”
pages.enText: The truck had stopped securely. The drivers confirmed their positions before the loader approached slowly. “Big bucket, time to rise!” An'an whispered.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Blue-cab gray-bed dump truck stationary, loader approaching side with safe clearance, enclosed operator cabs.

pages.zhText: 长长的举升臂把铲斗抬过车厢边。哗啦啦，沙子倒进去，像一场小小的金色雨。车厢里没有人，附近也没有人伸手去接。
pages.enText: The lifting arms raised the bucket above the bed. Whoosh! Sand poured in like a little golden shower. Nobody was in the bed or reaching beneath the bucket.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Sand pouring from elevated loader bucket into empty gray truck bed, no people underneath or inside bed.

pages.zhText: 第一斗落在前面，下一斗换个位置。沙子分布均匀，不能全挤在一边。安安把两只手摊平：“要让车厢站得稳稳的！”
pages.enText: The first scoop went toward the front; the next went elsewhere. The sand needed to be spread evenly, not piled on one side. An'an held out both hands. “Keep it balanced!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Overhead truck bed with sand distributed evenly, loader depositing second modest scoop.

pages.zhText: 还差一点，装载机却停下来。原来要先确认重量，不能因为车厢还有空，就一直加。安安点头：“不是装得越满越好。”
pages.enText: A little more seemed possible, but the loader stopped. The load had to be checked; empty space did not mean more could be added. “Fuller is not always better,” An'an nodded.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Stationary loaded truck on level loading area, workers check blank weigh record from safe station, loader grounded bucket.

pages.zhText: 运输车盖好篷布，沿着安排好的路出发。装载机把铲斗放低，继续整理材料区。它们一个装，一个运，各有各的本领。
pages.enText: The truck covered its load and followed the planned route. The loader lowered its bucket and tidied the material area. One loaded, the other carried: each had its own skill.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Covered blue truck departing yard, loader with low bucket in separate safe lane, wide balanced composition.

pages.zhText: 过些日子，公园的沙坑开放了。安安挖了一条小河，还堆了一座小桥：“原来这些沙，是大铲斗一趟趟送来的！”
pages.enText: Later, the sandpit opened. An'an dug a tiny river and made a bridge. “These grains came here scoop by scoop in that big bucket!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Completed public park sandpit, An'an with pail and Mom kneeling nearby, safe toy sand bridge.

pages.zhText: 在家里，安安用小铲把大积木装进玩具车。你来猜：堆得高高的一铲，还是稳稳的一小铲，更容易不撒出来？妈妈在旁边陪着玩。
pages.enText: At home, Mom supervised as An'an scooped large blocks into a toy truck. Which would spill less: a towering scoop or a small, steady one?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Supervised tabletop large age-appropriate toy blocks, rounded scoop and toy truck, visual modest versus overloaded scoop comparison.

pages.zhText: 安安给今天的动作编了儿歌：“铲进去，收回来；低低走，停稳抬；轻轻倒，慢慢来。”妈妈拍着节奏，大铲斗仿佛又开工啦！
pages.enText: An'an made a rhyme: “Scoop it in and tilt it back. Carry low along the track. Stop, lift, tip—and take it slow!” Mom clapped, and their pretend loader went to work again.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Warm home pretend play toy loader and truck, An'an and Mom clapping rhythm beside finished sandpit drawing without text.

Mom: shoulder-length black hair, coral cardigan, cream trousers, tan shoulder bag. Recurring engineer Lin: Chinese woman with tied-back dark hair, white hard hat, orange reflective vest, navy trousers and work boots. During active construction An'an and Mom stay together OUTSIDE a sturdy fenced visitor area, well away from machinery. Only trained adult workers in hard hats, reflective vests and boots enter work zones. Home scenes have no worksite hazards. Same orange-yellow wheel loader, four large black tires, front lifting arms and broad bucket; companion blue-cab dump truck with gray level bed.
